refnamediv.refpurpose: Set the value of an SNMP object

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
boolsnmp3_set stringhostname stringsecurity_name stringsecurity_level stringauth_protocol stringauth_passphrase stringprivacy_protocol stringprivacy_passphrase arraystringobject_id arraystringtype arraystringvalue inttimeout-1 intretries-1
snmp3_set is used to set the value of an SNMP object specified by the object_id.
The authentication and privacy arguments must always be passed, but their values are ignored when security_level does not use them.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if:
hostname contains null bytes, is 128 bytes or longer, or has a port that is not between 0 and 65535.
security_name is empty or contains null bytes.
security_level is not one of the supported levels.
auth_protocol is not supported, when security_level is authNoPriv or authPriv.
privacy_protocol is not supported, when security_level is authPriv.
object_id is an empty array.
type is not a single character.
timeout is lower than -1.
retries is lower than -1 or greater than 2147483647.
